label: A great humbling comes upon America
description: A stiff-necked nation brought to its knees by mass chaos and confusion, with heads bowed low afterwards in humility, said to grieve the Lord greatly. Given 31 December 2025.

label: Turf wars between the Mexican cartels and the mafia
description: Territorial wars inside American cities between Mexican cartel networks and Italian-American organised crime, seen in Chicago, Boston, New Orleans and heavily in New York, with Sicily and Little Italy heard and Miami linked to Sicily. One side will present as freedom fighters. Given 29-30 December 2025.

label: A small girl in the cartel material, and her father
description: A girl of three or four seen and identified as an anchor baby inside the cartel material, later prayed over by name, with her father named as the reason. Given 29-30 December 2025.

label: Devices in water bottles and shoes rather than backpacks
description: Explosive devices built into a water bottle and into footwear rather than the backpacks and vests security is looking for, funded through Iran and described as a level up. Given 29 December 2025.
